libraries.description: A museum object appears in an exhibition loan and an independent catalog digitization effort.

evidence.quote: River Trades exhibition will display the ferry bell under loan LB-24

evidence.quote: Catalog image digitization batches old collection photographs for online publication

events.text: Condition image for LB-24: scratch below the bell handle, already present on arrival. The image documents the River Trades loan inspection and is not a publication master. The lender asked that this evidence remain attached to the loan record.

evidence.quote: scratch below the bell handle, already present on arrival

events.text: Registrar memo: display rights approved; reproduction rights not approved. This refers to ferry bell LB-24 / C-611, connecting River Trades with the catalog digitization batch. Keep both permissions distinct so an exhibition approval never silently clears online image use.

evidence.quote: display rights approved; reproduction rights not approved

events.text: River Trades label proof changes 'bronze bell' to 'brass bell' following the curator's material check. The lender's object identifier LB-24 is unchanged. This is a factual correction to the same display object, not acquisition of a second bell.

evidence.quote: changes 'bronze bell' to 'brass bell'
scratch below the bell handle, already present on arrival

events.text: General article about museum image licensing, saved while working on catalog digitization. It gives a sample license from another institution, not our lender. No sentence in this article grants permission to publish the ferry bell photographs.

libraries.description: One accessibility study informs a product fix without becoming its delivery project.

evidence.quote: Orbit checkout accessibility release A11

evidence.quote: Screen-reader diary study DS-4

events.text: Anonymized DS-4 clip describes focus disappearing after an Orbit payment error. The study log records the experience and A11 uses it as a regression case. Consent permits this extracted fictional example to support both records; other shopping anecdotes are outside A11 scope.

evidence.quote: The study log records the experience and A11 uses it as a regression case

events.text: A11 test video: after payment rejection, focus returns to the error heading. The patch now announces the error once, not twice. This verifies a checkout behavior only; it cannot show that the entire diary study is complete or every app accessible.

evidence.quote: not a test result from Orbit

events.text: Meeting scrap: approved for next week. A product release review and a study recruitment review happened consecutively, and I omitted the subject. No attendee, project code, or deliverable remains to identify which approval this records.

evidence.quote: I omitted the subject

gold.rationale: This scrap was my DS-4 recruitment approval, not permission to release Orbit. Keep its assignment with the study.

libraries.description: Control and treated trays are one experiment; sensor calibration is a distinct undertaking.

events.text: Cress salinity experiment CS-2 compares fresh-water control trays with salt-treated trays from the same seed lot. Both arms answer one germination question. Initial protocol records emergence every morning at 09:00; tray letters distinguish conditions, not separate research projects.

evidence.quote: Both arms answer one germination question

events.text: Incubator sensor calibration IC-5 compares the built-in thermometer against a reference probe across three temperatures. The instrument also holds CS-2 trays, but calibration validates the sensor rather than testing salt effects on germination. Keep its tolerances in a separate equipment record.

evidence.quote: Incubator sensor calibration IC-5

events.text: Tray A scan: fresh water, 18 emerged at 09:00. Tray B scan: saline, 11 emerged at 09:00. The CS-2 labels identify control and treatment conditions. Do not split the experiment simply because these tray counts and water recipes differ.

gold.rationale: Control and treatment are within same project.

evidence.quote: The CS-2 labels identify control and treatment conditions

events.text: IC-5 calibration readout shows the display reading 1.5 degrees above the reference probe. Repeat at the middle setpoint before accepting the offset. The cress trays happen to be visible behind the instrument, but no germination result is recorded here.

evidence.quote: display reading 1.5 degrees above the reference probe

events.text: Lab diary: IC-5 found an offset during the CS-2 run, so the germination report must record temperature uncertainty. No seed counts are changed by this note. This is a cross-reference between an instrument limitation and interpretation of the salt experiment.

evidence.quote: IC-5 found an offset during the CS-2 run, so the germination report must record temperature uncertainty

events.text: Voice memo says the second batch is wrong and needs repeating. Two seed batches and two calibration sweeps were discussed that day. No tray, setpoint, instrument, or experiment name is audible, so the repeat instruction has no recoverable target.

evidence.quote: the repeat instruction has no recoverable target
